🔥 nocodb | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly, no-code interface for creating and managing databases, with automatic API generation for easy integration into other applications.
✨ Key Features: • Free & Self-hostable Airtable Alternative • Build databases online • Automatic REST API generation • No-code platform • Support for multiple databases (PostgreSQL, SQLite)
📖 Summary: NocoDB is a free, self-hostable alternative to Airtable, enabling users to build databases online with ease. It provides a no-code platform that automatically generates REST APIs, allowing for seamless data management and integration.
